name: Despayre
description: Despayre, originally known as Horuz, was a planet in the Horuz system in the Outer Rim Territories, that served as a massive penal and slave world for the Galactic Empire and as a location where the first Death Star was constructed and completed, after being relocated many times to avoid Alliance to Restore the Republic.
